title: Technology Evaluation
description: Structured output of the tech-evaluation skill: a subagent's investigation of a library, dependency, or file format against a fixed question set, ending in one unambiguous recommendation.

title.description: e.g. 'Evaluating usage-rs as the CLI argument-parsing crate'

technology.description: The library, dependency, or format under evaluation (name + where to find it, e.g. an npm package or repo URL)

alternatives_considered.description: Other options already ruled out or being compared against, so the reader knows the field was actually surveyed

questions.description: One entry per evaluation dimension. Defaults to five (correctness, integration_fit, footprint, maturity, practical_fit) but a caller may substitute its own set when the default doesn't fit the technology.

verdict.description: A direct answer to the question, not a restatement of it

evidence.description: What was actually checked to reach this verdict -- a claim without a source is a guess, not a finding

source.description: File path with line number, a URL, or a specific doc/API reference -- not 'the docs' or 'general knowledge'

verdict.description: 'needs_more_research' is a legitimate verdict when evidence is genuinely inconclusive -- it must not be used to avoid picking a side when the evidence already supports one

rationale.description: Why this verdict, referencing the questions/evidence above. Must not hedge -- 'it depends' or 'both are valid' is not a rationale, it's a refusal to conclude

single_action.description: One imperative sentence: what the reader should do next. Exactly one action, not a menu of options
